subject: Partner private-offer activation roadmap & gating items
messages:
From: Jason Miller <jason@resellco.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Tran <emily@resellco.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: ResellCo request for Channel Private Offer (next steps)

Hi Evelyn / Ben —

Thanks again for the call this morning. ResellCo is ready to move forward with an AWS Channel Private Offer to bundle Redwood’s inference offering into our managed AI stack. To keep momentum we want to lock an activation roadmap and confirm gating docs on our side.

High level asks from ResellCo:
- Can Redwood provide a MOP (Marketplace Offer Proposal) template or example attachments for CPPO submission?
- SKU / product-code mapping we need to display on the listing and reconcile with our billing system.
- Legal/reseller letter template and the minimal commercial terms expected.

I attached our internal intake form (resellco_mop_request_form.pdf) to show how we capture entitlements and SKUs.

What would a 2-week activation plan look like from Redwood’s side? Proposed kickoff 8/31 if that works.

Thanks,
Jason Miller
Head of Channels
ResellCo

---
Attachment: resellco_mop_request_form.pdf (pdf)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Jason Miller <jason@resellco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: ResellCo request for Channel Private Offer (next steps)

Jason —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the form — that helps a lot. Below is a concise 2-week activation roadmap we can execute with ResellCo, plus gating items. I copied Laura for legal intake.

Activation roadmap (target go-live in ~2 weeks):
1) Day 0–1: Intake review (Redwood to validate entitlements + SKU mapping). Please confirm the product codes you plan to surface.
2) Day 2–4: Redwood prepares CPPO submission bundle (MOP draft, SKU matrix, commercial summary).
3) Day 5: Internal review (legal & finance sign-off).
4) Day 6–9: Submit CPPO to AWS/Channel for processing; begin AWS co-sell registration.
5) Day 10–14: AWS validation and publish window; final QA on offer listing and pricing.

Gating items we need from ResellCo (before Day 2):
- Signed reseller letter or commitment (see sample attached).
- Final SKU mapping spreadsheet (format: sku, display_name, unit_price, meter_id).
- Confirmation of support SLAs and passthrough billing cadence.

I attached a simple SKU mapping template (sku_mapping_v1.xlsx) and a reseller_letter_sample.docx for your legal team.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2026-08-31 @ 09:00 PT — 30 minutes to align on intake and owners. If that works, Ben and I will send calendar invite and pre-read.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: sku_mapping_v1.xlsx (xlsx), reseller_letter_sample.docx (docx)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jason Miller <jason@resellco.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: ResellCo request for Channel Private Offer (next steps)

Quick note on pricing & SKUs —

Jason, I pulled together an initial SKU mapping and pricing notes (pricing_notes_v2.xlsx). Key things to confirm on your side:
- Which metering model you want us to reflect (vCPU-min, token-based, or seat). For most of your managed workloads token-based is simplest.
- Whether you'll resell at list or have a margin applied (we'll need to reflect that as an MCC in the CPPO submission).
- Entitlement bundling: do you want separate SKUs for inference and embeddings or a single combined SKU?

If you can mark up the attached spreadsheet with preferred metering & price points by EOW, we can lock the MOP by Day 3.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: pricing_notes_v2.xlsx (xlsx), sku_mapping_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Jason Miller <jason@resellco.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: ResellCo request for Channel Private Offer (next steps)

Jason / ResellCo legal —

Looping in a few legal items to speed review:
- We can use the reseller_letter_sample.docx as the base; please return a signed PDF. Minimum needed: confirmation of reseller status, tax id, and acceptance of Redwood standard marketplace T&Cs.
- If you anticipate contract redlines (payment terms or indemnity), flag them now so we can triage.
- DocuSign fast-track: I can issue a short form through DocuSign to collect signatures if you prefer.

Also, for AWS CPPO there is often a short seller validation step. Please ensure your AWS Marketplace account is in good standing and we have your Marketplace Seller ID — share that in the intake sheet.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: reseller_letter_sample.docx (docx)
From: Jason Miller <jason@resellco.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: ResellCo request for Channel Private Offer (next steps)

Thanks everyone — we're aligned to proceed. Action items from ResellCo:
- Emily (cc) will return a signed reseller letter by Monday 8/30.
- We'll annotate sku_mapping_v1.xlsx with metering choice (token-based) and price bands by region.
- Emily will confirm our AWS Marketplace Seller ID in the intake sheet.

Proposed kickoff remains Tue 8/31 @ 09:00 PT — please send calendar invite and pre-read. We prefer DocuSign for the letter (fast).

Appreciate the clear roadmap — excited to get this live.

Jason Miller
Head of Channels | ResellCo
